# From digital to intelligent bankingWe're building what's next

interface.ai helps financial institutions leapfrog from digital banking to intelligent banking. We empower organizations to scale efficiently, serve customers smarter, and create connected, human experiences – all powered by AI.

![Global team of interface.ai people mapped across the world](https://interface.ai/_next/image?url=%2Flp%2Fcareers%2FFrame-151-min.webp&w=3840&q=75&dpl=dpl_7SxGrS45vF4fFWZRZ8Y3SLx57Chc) [Open Positions](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/interface-ai)

## Our mission and vision remain at the heart of everything we do

Our mission

Empower every financial institution to scale efficiently and help their customers achieve financial wellness.

Our vision

To help financial institutions leapfrog from digital to intelligent banking, and continually set the pace for AI in the industry.

### Who we are

interface.ai is the intelligent banking partner behind the world's most innovative financial institutions. As the AI leader in financial services, we are transforming how credit unions and banks connect with their customers – enabling them to deliver personalized, always-on service that feels human, efficient, and secure.

We're driven by one belief: when technology empowers people, everyone wins – customers, employees, and institutions alike.

![](https://interface.ai/_next/image?url=%2Flp%2Fcareers%2Fwho-we-are.webp&w=1920&q=75&dpl=dpl_7SxGrS45vF4fFWZRZ8Y3SLx57Chc)

### Built on innovation

Since our founding, we've set out to reimagine what banking can be and how it should feel. From automating everyday transactions to personalizing customer conversations, interface.ai gives financial institutions the intelligence to serve better and grow faster.

### Growing with innovation

200+ Financial Institutions served globally

Millions of AI-powered interactions every month

24/7 intelligent service with 90% automation accuracy

Trusted by 100+ banks and CUs globally

Raised $30M; most valuable agentic banking AI company

### Growing with purpose

We're the partner behind intelligent banking, helping teams modernize customer experiences, streamline operations, and build the banks of the future.

Our customers include credit unions and banks of every size – from community-focused institutions to global enterprises – all using interface.ai to build trust, loyalty, and growth through automation.

### Company timeline & growth highlights

2015–2018

Foundational R&D

Operated as Payjo, building AI powered payment solutions and early AI assistants for financial institutions in emerging markets.

Focused on conversational AI and early chatbot adoption.

2019

interface.ai is Born

Rebranded and launched in the U.S. with a focus on mid-sized banks and credit unions.

Vision for BankGPT – a proactive, AI-first financial concierge – takes shape.

2021

Early Growth

Crossed $2M in revenue.

Platform matured from embedded AI to unified, cross-channel AI systems.

2022–2023

Market Expansion

Built deep ecosystem partnerships and integrations (core banking, mobile, fraud systems).

Grew daily AI conversations to 1M+, launched Frontline AI and Chat AI suites.

2024

Funded & Scaling

Secured $30M in Series A funding after bootstrapping.

Became the most valuable AI company in banking.

ARR in tens of millions, targeting $100M+.

Launched Agentic AI agents (Orbit, Sphere, Nexus) and Biometric/Call Forensics AI tools.

2025

Scaling with Intent

Serving 100+ financial institutions, reaching 16M+ end users.

Processing 1.5M+ AI interactions daily.

Introduced Dynamic Knowledge, Cloned AI Voices and Smarter Card Experiences.

Positioned to lead the $200B+ intelligent banking transformation market.

### Benefits & work-life balance

Health Coverage

We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees and contribute toward dependents. Benefits are administered through Justworks and begin on the first of the month after your start date.

401(k) Match

We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Family & Reproductive Health Support (via Kindbody)

Access to fertility planning, IVF support, and family-building care through Kindbody.

Virtual Care & Wellness Support

Includes One Medical, Teladoc for 24/7 virtual care, Talkspace therapy sessions, and mental health support at no additional cost.

Ancillary Benefits

Company-paid life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability, with optional supplemental coverage available.

Remote / Hybrid Work

You can work remotely or in a hybrid setup. Performance matters more than location.

Parental Leave

Paid leave for new parents with full job protection.

PTO (DPTO Model)

Take time off when needed. No accrual banks or waiting periods. Submit a request and coordinate with your manager.

Flexibility

You control your schedule and working style. We prioritize outcomes, not hours.

Free Food

Enjoy complimentary meals when working from our Palo Alto office, so you can stay focused without worrying about lunch.
